description: List of all active departments from dim_departments table

query_text:
SELECT subdept_id, subdept_name, dept_id, subdept_code
     FROM dim_subdepartments
     WHERE dept_id = ANY(:department_ids)
     AND is_active = true

query_text:
SELECT
        period_code as value,
        period_label as label,
        start_date,
        end_date
     FROM (
        VALUES
            ('today', 'Today', CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE),
            ('yesterday', 'Yesterday', CURRENT_DATE - 1, CURRENT_DATE - 1),
            ('last_7_days', 'Last 7 Days', CURRENT_DATE - 7, CURRENT_DATE),
            ('last_30_days', 'Last 30 Days', CURRENT_DATE - 30, CURRENT_DATE),
            ('this_month', 'This Month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE), CURRENT_DATE),
            ('last_month', 'Last Month', DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month'), DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - 1)
     ) AS periods(period_code, period_label, start_date, end_date)

SELECT
        status_code as value,
        status_label as label,
        display_color
     FROM (
        VALUES
            ('draft', 'Draft', 'gray'),
            ('active', 'Active', 'green'),
            ('scheduled', 'Scheduled', 'blue'),
            ('completed', 'Completed', 'purple'),
            ('cancelled', 'Cancelled', 'red')
     ) AS statuses(status_code, status_label, display_color)
